CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS browser_use_workflows (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        distributor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        client_id TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('recording', 'saved', 'interrupted')),
        steps_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        skipped_actions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        pending_actions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS browser_use_workflow_runs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        distributor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'pending', 'interrupted', 'completed', 'cancelled')),
        next_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        tab_id TEXT,
        client_id TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES browser_use_workflows(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_browser_use_workflows_distributor ON browser_use_workflows(distributor_id, status, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_browser_use_workflow_runs_distributor ON browser_use_workflow_runs(distributor_id, status, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS browser_use_connections (
        distributor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (
            status IN ('active', 'revoked')
        ),
        connected_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        revoked_at TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS browser_use_clients (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        distributor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        label TEXT NOT NULL,
        browser_family TEXT NOT NULL,
        profile_name TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (
            status IN ('active', 'revoked')
        ),
        connected_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        revoked_at TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS browser_use_preferences (
        distributor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        preferred_client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS browser_use_audit_events (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        distributor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        action TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
            status IN ('pending', 'completed', 'failed', 'timed_out')
        ),
        target_origin TEXT,
        error_message TEXT,
        started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        finished_at TEXT
    )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_browser_use_audit_distributor_started ON browser_use_audit_events(distributor_id, started_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_browser_use_clients_distributor ON browser_use_clients(distributor_id, status, last_seen_at)
